deep.reconstruction:
This page is the last step of a proof of the Hölder inequality for Schatten–von Neumann classes, written as a two-variable minimisation.

Setting from the previous page:
- S_p(A) almost certainly denotes the sum of the p-th powers of the singular values of the compact operator A, i.e. ||A||_p^p. This is inferred from the normalisation, not written out on the page.
- The exponents satisfy 1/r = 1/p + 1/q.
- A Young-type inequality (1/r) S_r(AB) ≤ (1/p) S_p(A) + (1/q) S_q(B) is assumed, presumably proved earlier.

The homogenisation step:
- Replacing A by λA and B by μB gives ((λμ)^r / r) S_r(AB) ≤ (λ^p/p) S_p(A) + (μ^q/q) S_q(B).
- Put a = S_p(A), b = S_q(B), c = S_r(AB), x = λ^p, y = μ^q, α = r/p, β = r/q, so α + β = 1.
- Then c ≤ inf over x, y ≥ 0 with x^α y^β = 1 of (αax + βby).
- A Lagrange-multiplier argument on the previous page gives the extremum condition ax = by. Hence the minimum value is (α+β)ax = ax.

This page:
- Using x^α y^β = 1 together with y = ax/b gives x^{α+β}(a/b)^β = 1, so x = (b/a)^β.
- Therefore the minimum is ax = a^{1-β} b^β = a^α b^β.
- So c ≤ a^α b^β, which ends the proof. In norms this reads ||AB||_r^r ≤ ||A||_p^r ||B||_q^r, i.e. ||AB||_r ≤ ||A||_p ||B||_q.

Context: this is part of Grothendieck's 1953 functional-analysis notes on trace-class and Schatten ideals, around the period of his work on nuclear operators and tensor products. It is the standard trick of upgrading an additive (Young) inequality to a multiplicative (Hölder) one by rescaling.
errors: No mathematical error on this page. The computation x = (b/a)^β and ax = a^α b^β is correct given α+β = 1.
A struck-out symbol (an α or β) under b^β is a cancelled slip.

Minor gap carried over from the previous page: the compactness argument for attainment of the infimum is sketchy. The case a = 0 or b = 0 is not treated (the infimum is then 0, consistent with the formula), though this is trivial.

ideas.what: Deriving the Hölder inequality for Schatten classes, ||AB||_r ≤ ||A||_p ||B||_q with 1/r = 1/p + 1/q, from a Young-type additive inequality by homogeneity (rescaling A and B) and minimising over the scaling parameters.
ideas.modern_name: Hölder inequality for Schatten–von Neumann ideals, via the homogenisation/scaling trick
ideas.usually_credited_to: von Neumann, Schatten (1940s); Dixmier (1953); later McCarthy (1967), Gohberg–Krein, Simon
ideas.where_published: Possibly implicit in Grothendieck's work on nuclear and Fredholm operators (Produits tensoriels topologiques, 1955; La théorie de Fredholm, 1956), but no explicit statement is known to me.

ideas.what: Constrained minimisation of αax + βby subject to x^α y^β = 1, giving the minimum a^α b^β (the weighted AM–GM equality case).

deep.surprise_reason: This is the routine closing computation of a standard proof of the Hölder inequality for Schatten classes, already known by 1953 (Schatten–von Neumann, Dixmier). It contains no new idea or connection.
transcription_corrections: The struck-out denominator under b^β appears to be a Greek letter (α or β), not a clear α. The final expression is ax = b^β a^{1-β} = a^α b^β.
'Si x^α y^β = 1 on trouve x = (b/a)^β, d'où le minimum donc ax = ...' is plausible. The struck word after 'd'où' is illegible.
The last lines likely read 'On trouve donc c ≤ a^α b^β, ce qui achève la démonstration.'
The archive pencil number at the bottom left is '141', not 139.
